d:
A property dispute has emerged within the Bachchan family over Amitabh Bachchan's iconic Jalsa bungalow in Mumbai.
Amitabh's sister-in-law, Ramola Bachchan, has challenged a 1993 Gift Deed through which the property's ownership was reportedly transferred to Jaya Bachchan.
Ramola claims that the transfer took place without her knowledge or consent and has raised questions about the document's legality.
